reviews.name: Marcus T.
reviews.text: From the first quote to delivery, everything was clear and on time. Our new double-wide looks just like the photos, and the price beat every other offer we got.

reviews.name: Danielle R.
reviews.text: Honest people who explained all the financing options without any pressure. We were moved into our home in about six weeks.

reviews.name: Kevin & Alicia W.
reviews.text: We bought two homes for our rental property and the bulk pricing saved us a real amount. Communication was excellent the whole way.

reviews.name: Tamika J.
reviews.text: The delivery crew was professional and setup went smoothly. The home arrived spotless and feels really well built.

reviews.name: Robert H.
reviews.text: They walked us through every option and helped us pick a floor plan that fit our budget. Couldn't be happier with the result.

reviews.name: Priscilla N.
reviews.text: Fast replies, an itemized quote and no surprises. I'd recommend them to any first-time buyer.

reviews.name: Gary S.
reviews.text: Great value and a quality home. Delivery came a couple of days later than first estimated, but they kept us updated the whole time.

reviews.name: Monica L.
reviews.text: Good selection and fair pricing. I wish a few listings had more photos, but the team answered every question I had.

reviews.name: Andre C.
reviews.text: Solid home and friendly service. The paperwork took a little longer than expected, but the end result was worth it.
